description: Implementation of a GLX window surface for EGL in the ANGLE project, managing window creation, destruction, resizing, and buffer swapping on X11/GLX systems.

classes.name: rx::WindowSurfaceGLX
classes.description: A class implementing an EGL surface using GLX for X11 windows, handling window creation, destruction, resizing, and buffer swapping.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the window surface, creating a child window with the correct visual and setting up GLX buffers.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Makes the surface current (no-op in this implementation).

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the front and back buffers, handling resize if needed.

methods.name: postSubBuffer
methods.description: Unimplemented method for posting a sub-buffer.

methods.name: querySurfacePointerANGLE
methods.description: Unimplemented method for querying surface pointer.

methods.name: bindTexImage
methods.description: Unimplemented method for binding a texture image.

methods.name: releaseTexImage
methods.description: Unimplemented method for releasing a texture image.

methods.name: setSwapInterval
methods.description: Sets the swap interval for buffer swapping.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the window, cached from parent.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the window, cached from parent.

methods.name: isPostSubBufferSupported
methods.description: Unimplemented method indicating if post sub-buffer is supported.

methods.name: getSwapBehavior
methods.description: Returns the swap behavior, here EGL_BUFFER_DESTROYED.

methods.name: checkForResize
methods.description: Checks if the parent window has resized and updates the window accordingly.

methods.name: getWindowDimensions
methods.description: Retrieves the dimensions of a given window.

methods.name: getSyncValues
methods.description: Retrieves synchronization timing values for the surface.
